meaning: The comment asserts that on this deck Pabdo is constant, so M1's transmural pressure is an exact affine function of Pds (corr = +1.00000), while M3's trace opens into a loop about 59% of the curve height versus about 2% against its own Ptm. These are stated findings baked into prose, not values the plot computes.

could_move.what: The keep mask that this comment says excludes the initial condition sets which samples enter the loop-height measure

expectation: Unknown. On a constant-Pabdo jugular-compression deck the correlation should be at or very near +1; on the Pabdo ramp and sweep decks it should fall below that, and the 59%/2% figures have no reason to hold. I cannot tell the size from the context.

check.why: Replots one deck where Pabdo is swept rather than constant, without re-fitting, so you can see whether the M1 trace is still single-valued against Pds as the comment claims.
